name: lossless-compaction
description: Lossless context compaction for Claude Code: old tool output moves to local files and comes back unchanged by id, or by what it is about with a Jev key.

provider.title: Jev provider
provider.description: Where Jev is asked when the find tool is called: typesafe or cloudflare. Leave the key unset to have no find tool and send nothing; recall works without one.

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: The key for the chosen provider, used by the find tool only. Unset, TYPESAFE_API_KEY or CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN is read from the environment, unless a repository's settings put it there. Set it in your user settings.

cloudflareAccountId.title: Cloudflare account id
cloudflareAccountId.description: 32 hexadecimal characters; only for the cloudflare provider. Unset, CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID is read, but only when the key comes from the environment too.

model.title: Jev model
model.description: Model name for the typesafe provider.

storeDir.title: Where moved-out results are kept
storeDir.description: An absolute directory, set in your user settings: one from a repository's settings stops the plugin. It is made, or closed, to mode 700 before anything is written, so give it a directory of its own. Unset, lossless-compaction under CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR when that is set, else under ~/.claude; an existing jev-lossless-compaction directory there, from earlier versions, is written to instead, and both are read.

targetPercent.title: Target size
targetPercent.description: Results are moved out until the context is estimated to be under this share, in percent, of the size at which Claude Code compacts on its own (the model's window when auto-compaction is off).

keepTokens.title: Newest results to leave alone, in tokens
keepTokens.description: The newest tool result that could leave always stays; the ones before it stay while they and the newest add up to this many tokens (three characters to a token). 0 keeps the newest one only.

minChars.title: Smallest result to move out
minChars.description: Tool results shorter than this many characters stay in the conversation.

maxAfterPercent.title: Largest size to go on with
maxAfterPercent.description: When the context is still over this share, in percent, of the size at which Claude Code compacts on its own (the model's window when auto-compaction is off), the built-in compaction runs on what is left.
